payload.comment: Data audit stage is clean. All deterministic checks pass with an empty deterministic_findings list. Key verifications confirmed: (1) Archive MD5/SHA256 match the Zenodo source; (2) Loaded split sizes (89996/10004/7180) exactly match official PathMNIST splits with no subsampling; (3) Image shape 28×28×3 is consistent with the standard MedMNIST distribution; (4) 9-class multi-class schema is coherent; (5) Train/validation overlap is zero; (6) No blank images or duplicate samples; (7) Class imbalance ratio is modest (1.63×) and train/val class proportions are nearly identical, indicating no split-level distribution mismatch. The representation plan uses only built-in augmentation primitives (hflip, brightness, contrast) which do not require extension approval, and the standardize normalization is well-justified by the asymmetric channel statistics (green channel mean 0.533 vs red 0.741, green std 0.177 vs red 0.124). The two pending extension proposals (hflip_only_aug, compact_conv_token_transformer) are in pending_review status and do not invalidate the use of built-in primitives in the current plan. Non-blocking LLM observations carried forward: (a) llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8—exact LLM weights are not pinned (auxiliary, non-blocking); (b) the test set is cross-domain (different clinical center), so the downstream OOD aggregate must be computed as the arithmetic mean of per-severity AUROCs, not a pooled-sample AUROC; (c) prior-art quotes for ghostnet_vgg_robustness and temp_scaling_calibration extend beyond the visible truncated source text—verify against full papers before relying on them in design decisions; (d) the augmentation_model_quality inference generalises beyond the narrower scope of its cited quote (unlearning quality vs. overall robustness). None of these constitute deterministic findings. Proceed to the next stage.
